svg.aria-label: Arrest recognition requires the person as well as the tracing

g.text: Arrest recognition requires the person as well as the tracing
Unresponsive + absent/abnormal breathing: follow the trained arrest assessment.
A: disorganized activity without identifiable QRS complexes - VF pattern
B: absent ventricular activity - check leads/connections while treating arrest
C: organized activity. With no pulse this is PEA, not a shockable rhythm.
Original teaching schematic. Not a patient ECG or a diagnostic simulator.
